name: Example Tavern Chatter
text:
The north road is muddy again.
Someone rang the chapel bell before dawn.
The ferryman has doubled his price.
A red fox slept beneath the market cart.
The old quarry is closed until further notice.
Travelers from the coast say the storms are getting worse.

sources.author: Playroma project example
sources.notes: Original demonstration text supplied with Phase 5.
